title: Have you tried making a game with AI on your phone?
author: zerry_rae
selftext:
I wanted to see how far I could go making games on my phone. So I’ve been scrolling through the App Store and testing out a bunch of game-making apps lately  (both AI-powered and not). Here’s the list I tried:

* [**Redbean** ](https://www.redbean.ai/)(iOs)– My fav so far. It’s super simple, just drop in an idea or image, then talk with the AI. The results are quick, but you’ll need to adjust a few things to really make it yours.
* [**Castle**](https://castle.xyz/) (iOs - Android) – You draw your own art, animate it, and add logic. Really creative and cool. Takes more time for details, but really cool if you like visuals.
* [**Sticky**](https://getstic.ky/) (iOs) – Has cool games on the feed and lets you pick by genre. Although it's slightly limited unless you pay for more prompts.
* [**Scratch**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/scratchjr/id895485086) (iOs) – Super classic, great for logic, but mobile version feels a bit limited (4 slides per project).
* [**Upit**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/upit-ai-game-maker/id6741482135) (iOs - Android) –  I’ve applied to be a creator, still waiting for approval so can’t say much about the editor. The game feed looks pretty diverse!

**My thoughts so far:** Most of these apps have community space that let me explore what others are building, really like it!  
I know there are limitations of course (small screen, not as powerful as PC), but I actually enjoy how easy and flexible it feels.

Has anyone else here tried making games on phone or tried these app? And do you got any favorite apps I should check out?
